_how: Settings for nudge.py, which Claude Code's hooks run. The kit's policy: a nudge at 300,000 tokens and at each extra 25,000; urgent from 400,000; after 500,000, every message the owner sends comes with a reminder to start a fresh chat; and a sub-agent's nudge at 300,000 tokens of its own conversation and each extra 25,000, urgent from 400,000. The nudge asks for the brain left current, not a quick hand-off: a new chat may never be started, so work can be left unfinished but not unrecorded. What each setting does is at the top of nudge.py and in the handoff skill. 0 turns a setting off.
message: Hand-off nudge: this conversation is about {size} tokens, past the {mark} mark. Don't take this as "start a new chat and it'll pick up". The job now is to leave the brain current. Save what was decided and learned in this conversation where it belongs, and bring the job's task note up to date with where you got to, so whichever agent works on the brain next knows. Work can be left unfinished; it can't be left unrecorded. How: the handoff skill (skills/handoff/SKILL.md). Then commit and push, and give the owner the task note's path to paste into a new chat with "continue", as a code block on its own (the path, then continue), never a link. If they carry on here, the next nudge comes at the next 25,000 tokens.
urgent_message: Hand-off nudge, urgent: this conversation is about {size} tokens, past {mark}. Long conversations get slower, use up the owner's plan faster and lose detail. Finish the step you're on, then bring the job's task note up to date now, the way the handoff skill (skills/handoff/SKILL.md) says, and urge the owner to paste its path into a new chat with "continue", as a code block on its own, never a link.
prompt_message: This conversation is about {size} tokens, past {mark}. Before anything else, tell the owner it's time to start a fresh chat. If the job's task note isn't up to date, update it the way the handoff skill (skills/handoff/SKILL.md) says, and give them its path to paste into the new chat with "continue", as a code block on its own, never a link.
agent_message: Sub-agent hand-off nudge: your own conversation is about {size} tokens, past the {mark} mark for agents. Finish the step you're on, then write your report back the way the handoff skill (skills/handoff/SKILL.md, "Briefs and reports") says: what's done, what's left, and where everything is. Then stop: the session that started you picks up from your report. If you carry on, the next nudge comes at the next 25,000 tokens.
agent_urgent_message: Sub-agent hand-off nudge, urgent: your own conversation is about {size} tokens, past {mark}. Stop now: write your report back the way the handoff skill (skills/handoff/SKILL.md, "Briefs and reports") says, with what's done, what's left and where everything is, push what you have, and stop. The session that started you picks up from your report.
